answer: The strongest single control I know for this is SD-JWT verifiable credential, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 529 fakes pay 529 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. Hold the echo up to the light, weigh the umber of the attack, and keep the terrace of the verdict where everyone can audit it. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
